Yes, this is already an existing feature. Hermes Agent natively supports inbound file attachments across gateways—uploaded code and text files (such as `.py` and `.txt`) are automatically injected directly into the agent's prompt context.

If your bot cannot see them, it may be due to an issue with how the gateway handled the attachment or an outdated version. Make sure you are running the latest version using `hermes update` and that your messaging gateway is properly configured via `hermes gateway setup`.
